title: My game called Wildlands, what are your opinions? Currently I am working on remodeling all bosses to look good.
author: Traditional-Area1456
selftext: I am also in need of some financial support to be able to afford chatgpt pro, so if anyone is down to help with a dollar or 2 I will be very grateful.

comments.author: PositiveScarcity8909
comments.body: What's the pipeline for the animations?

replies.author: Traditional-Area1456
replies.body: Gpt 6.1 is actually great at animating and listening to your prompts if you explain it all in detail, so I just use 6.1 and blender for checking the anims.

comments.author: lark_devon
comments.body: its ok I guess. are you like making a game you wished you'd played that doesn't exist or something?

replies.author: Traditional-Area1456
replies.body: oh well you got that hahah, yeah and this part of the game just looks like the good ole medieval slop type of thing, but I have plans for this that will be insane if I can pull it off, sadly I don't know how much I can do since the plus subscription is limiting me and it's very impactful on the progress haha

comments.author: cxfoulke
comments.body:
the lack of any hit  feedback is really bad. Like with the fidelity your at... I couldnt tell you if those hits hit or not.  

Thats your easiest fix but... the games a long way like most of the animations are very glitchy limbs passing through bodies.. you pass through the boss a bunch etc. 

The thing to think about going forward... Is if Ai can make this for you what makes it different for someone else. You really need to be pushing its capabilities to the max.  This doesnt really stand out from something I could 1 shot prompt.

replies.author: Traditional-Area1456
replies.body: Yes of course, I acknowledged that myself today when i thought about what else I could do to make it more immersive and fun, I thought of adding hitstop with bigger blood particles that really make for some gritty hits if you understand me. Thank you for the feedback! I will keep you all up to date with future progress

replies.author: PHNTMS_exe
replies.body: First impressions mean a lot. You need to cook for like 3-9 months

replies.author: Traditional-Area1456
replies.body: trying to get a pro sub and I will cook non stop

comments.author: Happy_Variety5405
comments.body: The cape has a lot of clipping

replies.author: Traditional-Area1456
replies.body: yeah its freakin horrible, I will be fixing that, the game is kinda early in development and I am focused on making the world first and foremost, at first I started focusing on animations and combat too much and forgot about the map, which is what I will be focusing on from now onwards. Thanks for the feedback though I love that I'm not the only one annoyed with the clipping lmao

comments.author: EthelUltima
comments.body: The simple graphics are ok but there is so much clipping and bad animations it just makes it awful. Like no thought or care went into it.

replies.author: Traditional-Area1456
replies.body: Yep, I can see where you're coming from, but I will fix that in the future, the combat feels fluid when you're playing it, but on video it looks like crap lol

replies.author: Early_Flamingo5337
replies.body: Looks are even more important than feels to start to play a game

replies.author: Traditional-Area1456
replies.body: yup, I am working on the looks part, I still want it to have that retro feel but with a sprinkle of modern techniques.

comments.author: SphinxWar
comments.body: Animations look terrible. I am not sure why you wouldn't start with the most difficult parts like animations before having the world generated.

replies.author: Traditional-Area1456
replies.body: Because i don't want the world to be "generated", I am planning on thoroughly implementing changes to the world to make it feel worth exploring and very rewarding as well, I will take care of animations easier than you think

comments.author: PHNTMS_exe
comments.body: Too soon, people get too excited. Keep cooking.

replies.author: Traditional-Area1456
replies.body: yeahh I kinda expected some lashback, it's always the case on the internet haha, but I will be improving this so much as soon as I get my hands on a gpt pro subscription

comments.author: drahgon
comments.body: Mean if you’re going for like that Sprite style animation then it’s good for what it is. I could see this being a fun mobile game like steam deck game.

replies.author: Traditional-Area1456
replies.body: hahahah funny thing I actually do my testing on my steam deck, It's a great experience but also I am aiming to make this much better, this a completely unfinished product and I'm just showing a tiny bit of what I want to make. Thanks for the feedback!

comments.author: Flashfirez23
comments.body: Honestly focus on improving your graphics substantially. If your game doesn’t look good. No one is gonna wanna play it.

replies.author: Traditional-Area1456
replies.body: Yep, that's what I'm currently doing before adding anything new to the game, It's taking some time to remake everything but I have already remade all of the bosses to look better, next is the character and NPC models and after that I will carefully go through the map and make it a lot more fun to explore and look at in general. Thanks for the feedback.
